CustomField.inlineHelpText: Visual collection indicator. White: when there is no invoice; Yellow: when there is an invoice, it has not been collect, and the ETD+deadline date is greater than or equal to the current date; Red: when there is an invoice, it has not been collect, and the ETD+deadline date is less than the current date; Green: when there is an invoice and it has been collect
CustomField.label: Indicador de cobro
